extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, companies, nonprofits, tribes, and other potential applicants to U.S. Department of Energy Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI) funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Submitting and preparing applications, concept papers, prize entries, RFIs, or NOI responses for funding opportunities administered by DOE's Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI). Covers solicitations, deadlines, submission types, and alignment with DOE goals and legal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open, competitive process / use Funding Opportunity Exchange
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding is awarded through an open, competitive process hosted primarily on the Funding Opportunity eXCHANGE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must use the Funding Opportunity Exchange to find and submit to CMEI solicitations; check the Exchange to see past and current opportunities. Sign up for the CMEI funding listserv to receive updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit-based project selection with emphasis on benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Project selections are merit-based with an emphasis on potential energy, environmental, and economic benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should clearly demonstrate potential energy impacts, environmental improvements, and economic benefits to improve competitiveness in merit review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with DOE statutory mission and Administration/DOE policies
rubrics_metrics.description: DOE evaluates all funding opportunities to ensure initiatives are in line with the statutory mission of DOE and the policies and priorities of the Administration and DOE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate how the project supports DOE's mission and current Administration priorities; reviewers will consider mission/policy alignment as part of evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with laws, regulations, and fiscal responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: DOE is undertaking evaluations and awarding funding in accordance with all laws, regulations, and fiscal responsibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must meet legal, regulatory, and fiscal requirements; applicants should ensure eligibility, allowable costs, and required certifications are in order. DOE may apply additional legal or court-ordered notices as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for CMEI mission objectives (lower costs, de-risk private sector, integrated energy system)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI) invests in R&D to lower the cost of energy technologies, protect the private sector from financial risk, and help America build and sustain an integrated energy system that is reliable, resilient, and secure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competitive proposals will show how the work lowers technology costs, reduces private-sector financial risk, or advances reliability/resilience/security of the energy system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to solicitation-specific submission type and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities specify submission types (e.g., Concept Papers, Full Applications, Prize Phases) and open/close dates which applicants must follow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully follow the solicitation's stated submission type and deadline (e.g., concept paper due date vs full application due date). Missing or incorrect submission type/timing can render an application ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect prize/competition phase requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Prize and competition opportunities are structured in phases (e.g., Phase 1, Phase 2) with phase-specific requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure eligibility and deliverables meet the specific phase rules; review phase descriptions and timelines in the solicitation and on the Funding Opportunity Exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to RFIs and NOIs as appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: CMEI issues Requests for Information (RFIs) and Notices of Intent (NOIs) with close or opening dates that guide stakeholder engagement and upcoming solicitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use RFIs to provide feedback and inform program design; monitor NOIs for planned future solicitations and prepare accordingly. Observe RFI close dates and NOI schedules posted on the Funding Opportunity Exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology-area relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities are organized by technology area (e.g., Solar, Wind, Vehicles, Geothermal, Bioenergy, Advanced Materials & Manufacturing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit proposals that clearly align to the stated technology area and solicitation scope to ensure appropriate review and consideration.
